info.description:
bmcproxy exposes one vendor-neutral HTTP API over heterogeneous BMCs (Redfish, AMI MegaRAC /api, IPMI) and picks the right southbound protocol per board and firmware.

## Request model (no stored secrets)
Every BMC request names its target and carries the BMC's own credentials:
- `X-BMC-Host: <ip|host[:port]>` (required) selects the BMC.
- `Authorization: Basic base64(user:pass)` is the BMC's own account, passed through for the life of the request (never logged, never stored; sessions are cached in memory only, keyed by host+user+hash(password)).
- `X-BMC-Vendor: <driver>` (optional) forces a driver instead of auto-detection.
- `X-Request-Id` (optional) is echoed back; one is generated otherwise.

## Tiers
- `read`: never changes BMC state.
- `write`: reversible (LED, boot override, power, time).
- `disruptive`: may cut connectivity or lose data (network, BMC reset, firmware, log clear). Returns 403 unless the proxy runs with `--allow-disruptive` **and** the request carries `X-BMC-Confirm: true`.

## Errors
Errors use the envelope `{"error":{"status","class","message","request_id","debug"?}}` (debug block only in debug mode).
| Status | Class | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | invalid_argument | malformed request |
| 401 | auth | BMC rejected (or request lacks) credentials |
| 403 | disruptive_denied / forbidden | tier gate or proxy policy |
| 404 | not_found | object or route not found |
| 501 | unsupported | capability not supported by this BMC/driver |
| 502 | upstream | BMC error, with vendor detail |
| 503 | busy | BMC busy, connection-capped or circuit open |
| 504 | timeout | BMC did not answer in time |
info.title: bmcproxy API

post.description: Tier: **disruptive**: requires `--allow-disruptive` and `X-BMC-Confirm: true`. Body optional (default cold). All cached sessions to the BMC are dropped and the target is marked degraded while it reboots. ASRock AMI /api: `asrr/bmccoldreset`; Redfish: `Manager.Reset`; IPMI: mc reset cold.

get.description: Tier: **read**. Per-BMC status built from the proxy's target cache and transport stats: reachability (most recent success vs failure; an auth failure still counts as reachable), authenticated backends, board and firmware, circuit-breaker state, measured clock skew (warning above --skew-warn), degraded reason, negotiated TLS. Does not contact the BMC unless `probe=true`, which runs unauthenticated, non-mutating driver detection. Needs no credentials.

parameters.description: BMC address: ip, host or host:port
parameters.name: host

get.description: Tier: **read**. No AMI /api endpoint; Redfish: `Boot.BootSourceOverride*`; IPMI: chassis bootparam (X470 path).

put.description: Tier: **write**. target: none, pxe, disk, cd, usb, bios, floppy; mode: once, continuous, disabled; bootMode: uefi, legacy or empty. Redfish: `Boot.BootSourceOverride*` PATCH; IPMI: chassis bootdev.

get.description: Tier: **read**. Resolves the driver (auto-detected or `X-BMC-Vendor`), opens or reuses a session and reports, per generic capability, whether it is supported and which backend (redfish, ami, ipmi) serves it, plus the driver's vendor routes and their tiers. ASRock: detection via `asrr/model-name`/`asrr/fw-info` (AMI /api) or Redfish ServiceRoot; IPMI Get Device ID as fallback. Large clock skew is reported in `warnings`.

delete.description: Tier: **disruptive** (log data is lost): requires `--allow-disruptive` and `X-BMC-Confirm: true`, else 403. ASRock AMI /api: `DELETE logs/event`; Redfish: `LogService.ClearLog`; IPMI: sel clear.

get.description: Tier: **read**. Incremental by record id: pass the previous `lastId` as `since`. Each entry's `time` has `raw` (BMC clock) and `corrected` (raw minus the measured BMC clock offset, i.e. real UTC). ASRock AMI /api: `logs/event?LASTEVENTID=n`; Redfish: `LogServices/SEL/Entries`; IPMI: sel list.

parameters.description: Return entries after this record id
parameters.name: since

get.description: Tier: **read**. ASRock AMI /api: `asrr/fw-info`, `maintenance/hpm/componentversions`; Redfish: `FirmwareInventory`.
Tier: **read** (never cached).

post.description: Tier: **disruptive**: requires `--allow-disruptive` and `X-BMC-Confirm: true`. Pull: JSON `{component, imageUri}` (Redfish SimpleUpdate). Push: `application/octet-stream` body with `?component=&imageName=`. Returns 501 until the driver implements firmware update (PLAN milestone 5). Poll the returned task via `GET /api/v1/firmware/tasks/{id}`.

get.description: Tier: **read**. ASRock AMI /api: `fru`; Redfish: Chassis/Assembly; IPMI: fru.
Tier: **read**. Proxy liveness: version, uptime, compiled-in drivers (with priority and vendor-route count), live session and known-target counts. Never contacts a BMC; needs no credentials.

Tier: **read**. kind: cpus, memory, pcie, storage, baseboard; the matching field of the response is set. ASRock AMI /api: `host_inventory/*` (X470: `system_inventory/*`); Redfish: Processors, Memory, PCIeDevices, Storage. A kind the board cannot serve is 501.
Tier: **read**. Never cached or coalesced (the response carries a short-lived token). ASRock AMI /api: `kvm/token`, `remote_control/get/kvm/launch`. The KVM websocket proxy itself is out of v1 scope.
Tier: **read**. ASRock AMI /api: chassis identify status; Redfish: `IndicatorLED`; IPMI: chassis identify.

post.description: Tier: **write**. ASRock AMI /api: `actions/chassis-led`; Redfish: `IndicatorLED` PATCH; IPMI: chassis identify.

get.description: Tier: **read**. Times carry raw and skew-corrected values. ASRock AMI /api: `logs/audit`; Redfish: Manager `LogServices`.
Tier: **read**. ASRock AMI /api: `settings/network`; Redfish: `EthernetInterfaces`; IPMI: lan print.

put.description: Tier: **disruptive** (can cut BMC connectivity): requires `--allow-disruptive` and `X-BMC-Confirm: true`. Null fields are unchanged; the driver reads the full vendor object, mutates and writes it back. ASRock AMI /api: `PUT settings/network`; Redfish: `EthernetInterfaces` PATCH.

get.description: Tier: **read** (cached briefly). ASRock AMI /api: `chassis-status`; Redfish: `Systems/Self.PowerState`; IPMI: chassis status.

post.description:
Tier: **write**. Actions: on, off (hard), shutdown (graceful ACPI), cycle, reset, nmi. ASRock AMI /api: `actions/power` codes 1,0,5,2,3; Redfish: `ComputerSystem.Reset`; IPMI: chassis power.
The proxy never assumes the action took effect (a graceful shutdown can be silently ignored, e.g. mid-POST): it polls the power state until it reaches the expected state or `timeoutSeconds` passes. 200 = converged; 202 = accepted but not observed (see `warning`), or `wait=false`, or nmi.

get.description: Tier: **read**. ASRock: `asrr/GetPowerRestore` (B650) / IPMI chassis policy (X470); Redfish: `PowerRestorePolicy`.

put.description: Tier: **write**. ASRock: `asrr/SetPowerRestore` (B650) / IPMI chassis policy (X470); Redfish: `PowerRestorePolicy` PATCH.

get.description: Tier: **read** (cached briefly; N concurrent identical requests cost one BMC call). Units normalized (C, V, RPM, A, W, %); unset thresholds ("NA") are null. ASRock AMI /api: `sensors` (+`sdr`); Redfish: `Chassis/Self/Sensors`, Thermal, Power; IPMI: sdr elist.
Tier: **read**. ASRock AMI /api: `settings/services`; Redfish: `NetworkProtocol`.

Tier: **read** (cached briefly, concurrent calls coalesced). Manufacturer, board, serial, BMC/BIOS versions. ASRock AMI /api: `asrr/fw-info`, `firmware-info`, `asrr/model-name`; Redfish: `Systems/Self`, `Managers/Self`; IPMI: mc info.

Tier: **read** (coalesced, not cached). Also refreshes the proxy's measured clock offset used to correct event timestamps. ASRock AMI /api: `settings/date-time`; Redfish: Manager `DateTime`, `DateTimeLocalOffset` + `NetworkProtocol.NTP`.

put.description: Tier: **write**. Set `time` for a manual clock set, or `ntpEnabled`/`ntpServers`. The driver reads the full vendor object, mutates and writes it back (the X470 500s on partial bodies) and preserves timezone. NTP changes may restart BMC networking. Returns the re-read config (verify after write), or 204 if the re-read failed.

post.description: Tier: **write**. Sets the BMC clock to the proxy's current UTC (compensating for the measured offset) and returns the resulting config. ASRock AMI /api: `PUT settings/date-time`; Redfish: Manager `DateTime` PATCH.

get.description: Tier: **read**. Never includes passwords. ASRock AMI /api: `settings/users`; Redfish: `AccountService/Accounts`; IPMI: user list.
Tier: **read**. Both boards: `GET asrr/maintenance/BIOS/UpdateOption` {action} (preserve/clear NVRAM on flash; value encoding unverified).

post.description: Tier: **disruptive** (the BMC reboots; unreachable for ~1-3 minutes, every session on the host is lost). Both boards: `PUT asrr/bmccoldreset {}`. The proxy marks the session lost so the next call reopens.

get.description: Tier: **read**. Both boards: AMI /api `GET settings/network-bond` ({id,bond_enable,bond_mode,auto_configuration_enable}; B650 also bond_ifc).

post.description: Tier: **disruptive** (diagnostic data is lost). X470: `DELETE asrr/clearmcalog`. B650/B550: 501 (no handler). Returns 204.

get.description: Tier: **read**. Both boards: `GET asrr/maintenance/{C}/status` and `.../flash-progress`. Components per board: X470 BIOS, CPLD; B650 4.x BIOS, CPLD, FPGA, RETIMER; others 501. Accepted names: BIOS, CPLD, FPGA, RETIMER, PSU, BP.

post.description: Tier: **disruptive** (the BMC restarts its network). Both boards: `PUT settings/network-bond` with bond_enable=0 (full object; B650 bond_ifc = the interface to keep, default the current one). Body optional.

Tier: **disruptive** (the BMC restarts its network; the session may drop). Both boards: read `settings/network-bond`, then `PUT settings/network-bond` with the full object, bond_enable=1, the requested bond_mode and (B650/B550) bond_ifc. Mode defaults to the current one; interface is ignored on X470.

get.description: Tier: **read**. X470: `GET asrr/GetFanDuty` (FANn_Duty %). B650 4.x: `GET settings/fan/manual`.

Tier: **read**. X470: `GET asrr/settings/getfancontrolmode` (an array with one {mode1..mode16} object, live-confirmed on 2.32 with every fan at 0 = the default; the meaning of the other codes is unverified). B650 4.x: `GET settings/fan/mode`. Raw vendor object included.

Tier: **read**. X470: two-step per table, held under the per-host exclusive AMI lane so no other request interleaves: `POST asrr/settings/setopenlooptablenumber {table_numble}` then `GET asrr/settings/getfanopenloopcontroltable` (Get_Temp1..24/Get_Duty1..24); closed loop uses setcloselooptablenumber + getfancloseloopcontroltable. B650 4.x: `GET settings/fan/openloop` / `closedloop` (one call, no selection step).
Tier: **read**. X470 (and B650 1.x): `GET asrr/getvetobit` {vetobit}. B650 4.x/B550: `GET settings/ncsilinkup` {sharednic, sharednic2}. The dialect is chosen by board profile, probed when unknown.

get.description: Tier: **read**. Both boards: `GET asrr/getmcalog` {MCADump}. The dump file download (`asrr/mca-file`) is denylisted (it crashes the web backend).
Tier: **read**. Both boards: `GET settings/ncsi/mode` ({channel_number, interface_name, mode, package_id}; B650 adds active).
Tier: **read**. X470 (and B650 1.x): `GET asrr/getbioscode` {poststatus, postdata}. B650 4.x: `GET logs/postcode`.
Tier: **read**. Both boards: `GET asrr/PowerSource` (per-PSU AC input / 12 V output). Boards without PMBus PSUs return zero rows or 501.
Tier: **read**. X470 only: `GET asrr/getprochot` {prochot}. B650/B550: 501.

delete.description: Tier: **dynamic** — GET/HEAD/OPTIONS read; DELETE disruptive; POST/PUT/PATCH disruptive when the path matches flash/firmware/upgrade/upload/hpm/maintenance/restore/reset/factory/network/ncsi/users/logs, else write. Sends the request through the proxy's authenticated AMI session (CSRF token, cookie, cc:7 re-login) to `/api/{path}` with the query string and body as given; the BMC status, body and content type are returned verbatim. Always refused (403 forbidden): `logs/help-data`, `asrr/mca-file`, `settings/download_image`, `maintenance/download_config`, `hpm/*status`, GlobalLuaTables, X470 `asrr/java-console`, and `session` (would log out the shared session). Method-override headers are stripped. Both boards (B650 `/api` works alongside Redfish).

put.description: Tier: **dynamic** — GET/HEAD/OPTIONS read; DELETE disruptive; POST/PATCH/PUT disruptive for UpdateService, AccountService, SessionService, EthernetInterfaces, NetworkProtocol, certificates, *.Reset, ResetToDefaults, ClearLog, SimpleUpdate, firmware, else write. Forwards to `/redfish/v1/{path}` with the proxy's authenticated Redfish client (If-Match / Content-Type forwarded); the BMC status and body are returned verbatim. B650: available. X470: 501 — Redfish keeps a separate account store and the driver does not use it (unless built with `-tags x470_pam` and PAM was enabled). Refused (403): GlobalLuaTables (unauthenticated, DELETE clears the Lua cache) and session create/delete.

post.description: Tier: **write**. X470: `POST asrr/settings/setclearallfansetting`. B650 4.x: `POST settings/fan/load_default`. Returns 204.
Tier: **write**. X470: `POST asrr/settings/setfancontrolmode` (full mode1..16 object; unspecified fans keep their mode). B650 4.x: `PUT settings/fan/mode` (raw object merged over the current one).

requestBody.description: modes keyed by fan number 1..16 (X470), or raw vendor fields (B650)

post.description: Tier: **write**. X470: one `POST asrr/settings/setfanopenloopcontroltable` {table_numble 1..8, temp1..24, duty1..24} or `setfancloseloopcontroltable` {table_numble 1..10 plus the closed-loop fields in raw} (names and keys from the X470 UI JS; never written on hardware). B650 4.x: `PUT settings/fan/openloop/{table}` / `closedloop/{table}` (raw object; the collections themselves are GET-only). Returns 204.
Tier: **write**. X470: `PUT asrr/setvetobit` {vetobit}. B650 4.x: `PUT settings/ncsilinkup` {sharednic, sharednic2} (enabled sets both unless given individually).

Tier: **write**. X470: `POST asrr/settings/setfandutymanualmode` {duty1..16} (fans must be in manual mode). B650 4.x: `PUT settings/fan/manual` (raw object merged over the current one). Duty is 0..100 percent. Returns 204.

requestBody.description: duties in percent keyed by fan number 1..16

post.description: Tier: **disruptive** (the shared-NIC link can drop). Both boards: read `settings/ncsi/mode`, merge the given fields, `PUT settings/ncsi/mode` with the full object.
Tier: **write**. X470 only: `PUT asrr/setprochot` {prochot}. B650/B550: 501.
Tier: **write**. Both boards: `POST asrr/setWebEnableTimeout` {enable_timeout}.
Tier: **disruptive**. Planned: `asrr/maintenance/{C}/firmware` upload, `upgrade`, then poll `flash-progress`. Not implemented in v1: always 501 after validating the component name.

get.description: Requires `--debug-endpoints`; loopback clients only. Live sessions with host, user, driver, age, idle time and remaining TTL. Never includes passwords, tokens or credential hashes (`id` is an opaque per-credential identifier).

Requires `--debug-endpoints`; loopback clients only. Per-host southbound counters (requests, errors by class, retries, limiter queue depth, breaker, latency histogram), session counters (relogins), cache hit rate.
Requires `--debug-endpoints`; loopback clients only. Per-host detected vendor, board, firmware, negotiated TLS, authenticated backends, last probe, clock skew, degraded state.

Prometheus text exposition from a private registry. Series include `bmcproxy_http_requests_total{host,route,code,class}`, `bmcproxy_http_request_duration_seconds{route}`, `bmcproxy_southbound_requests_total{host,class}`, `bmcproxy_southbound_latency_seconds{host}`, `bmcproxy_breaker_state{host}` (0 closed, 1 half-open, 2 open), `bmcproxy_sessions_live`, `bmcproxy_session_relogins_total`, `bmcproxy_cache_hits_total`/`_misses_total`/`_coalesced_total`, `bmcproxy_cache_hit_ratio`, lane in-flight/queued gauges, plus Go/process collectors.
